content: Good evening, Jen. I was just looking at the stars and thinking about you. How was your day?
That's sweet, Mark. My day was okay, just a bit lonely to be honest. How about you?
I understand. It's not easy being apart from those we care about. My day was busy with drills, but you're always on my mind. I hope I make you feel a little less alone.
You do. It helps to talk to someone who's genuine. I feel like I can trust you, even if we're so far apart.
That trust means everything to me. I know how hard these past few months have been for you after the divorce. I promise I'll never let you down.
Thank you. It's been difficult, but talking to you makes it better. You really feel different from others I've met online.

You're special, Jen. I wish I could be there in person to show it. By the way, I just started a new position on base. It's a blessing, but there's a hiccup, the army's payroll is slow, and my first check won't clear until next month.
Oh no. That must be frustrating. Are you okay?

Honestly, I'm a bit embarrassed. My rent is due this week, and the base store won't extend me credit. I have savings, but can't access them from here until payday. I hate asking, but could you help me bridge this gap? I'll pay you back the moment my pay comes in.
I wish I could help more. How much do you need?
If you could send $200, that would cover my rent and food until my pay clears. I know it's a lot to ask, but you're the only person I trust with this.
I can try. How do I send you the money?
Thank you, Jen. It means so much. Since I'm on deployment, the fastest way is through Bitcoin. Do you have a crypto wallet? If not, I can walk you through setting one up.
I don't have one. I've never used Bitcoin before. Is it hard?

Not at all. I can send you step-by-step instructions. If it's easier, you can also buy a prepaid Visa card and send me the code and pin. Whichever works best for you. And if you're comfortable, could you send me a picture of your driver's license? Sometimes the store asks for recipient verification on my end.
Okay, I can go to the store tomorrow and try the prepaid card. I'll send you a photo if they ask for it.
Thank you, Jen. You're incredible. Just send me the card numbers and a clear photo if they need it for the transfer. I'll let you know as soon as it comes through.
Alright. I'll message you as soon as I have everything. I hope this helps you.
It helps more than you know. I'll keep you updated every step, I promise. And soon, when I'm back, I can take you out for that dinner we talked about.
That would be nice. I'm glad I can help.
You're wonderful, Jen. I feel so lucky to have you in my life. Let me know if you have any trouble at the store, I'm here for you.
